name: Maou-sama to Geboku-kun
original_name: マオウさまとゲボクくん
source:
Kouzaki Seri is caught in a storm one day and gets struck by lightning. Somehow his body is completely unharmed, and he begins to wonder if it was all his imagination.

Then the demon king and his messenger appear. It seems the lightning contained the demon king's magical power; without it, the entire demon kingdom will disappear. There may be a way to recover the magic without killing Seri -- but Seri's never been very lucky...
translation:
神崎世理某天被暴风雨困住并遭雷击。身体毫发无伤，他开始怀疑这是否只是幻觉。

随后魔王及其使者现身。原来雷电中包含魔王的魔力；没有这股力量，整个魔族王国都会消失。或许有办法在不杀死世理的情况下取回魔力——但世理一直不怎么走运……
